scripts.prepare: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cp=require('child_process');if(!fs.existsSync('scripts/setup-git-hooks.mjs')){console.log('[prepare] setup-git-hooks ausente, ignorado neste ambiente.');process.exit(0);}try{cp.execSync('node scripts/setup-git-hooks.mjs',{stdio:'inherit'});}catch{console.log('[prepare] setup-git-hooks ignorado.');}"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
